title: AWS SageMaker SFT — Standard (prompt/completion) Format
description: Export schema for SageMaker serverless model customization SFT jobs using the Standard format. One JSON object per line in a .jsonl file.

system.description: Optional system prompt (some models support this field)

_examples.prompt: How do I reset my password?
_examples.completion: To reset your password, go to Settings > Security > Change Password. Enter your current password and then your new password twice to confirm.

_examples.system: You are a helpful customer service assistant.
_examples.prompt: Macam mana nak check baki prepaid?
_examples.completion: Untuk semak baki prepaid anda, sila dail *124# dari telefon anda atau gunakan aplikasi MyApp.
